After a forced Quirk Marriage to Momo Yaoyorozu ends in betrayal and death, he awakens before Mr. Fool, who resurrects him eleven years into the past as his Blessed, wielding the Lord of Mysteries System. items.synopsis_original:
What if the greatest mystery behind Quirks isn’t their beginning—but their end?

…

Raised in a secret underground lab, experimented upon, and robbed of a childhood, Luke’s gift isn’t flashy strength. It is Bioalchemy — a Quirk that bestows Quirks… but only by unraveling the laws of biology.

Eight years after the Final War, as a price of his freedom, he is forced into a Quirk Marriage with Momo Yaoyorozu—the one person who would see him as more than just a tool for others’ ambitions.

But before their child—the perfect fusion of creation and life—is born, a betrayal steals their future.

Fire. Screams. Ashes.

And then—nothing.

In death, Luke awakens in the Gray Castle seated before an incomprehensible entity—Mr. Fool.

“A price is exacted for what fate bestows,” Mr. Fool says, offering resurrection — on one condition — Luke will become His Blessed and must spread His faith.

Eleven years in the past, a young Luke finds himself facing a notification—

[Congratulations! Welcome to the Lord of Mysteries System! You have unlocked Sequence 9: Seer, Marauder, Apprentice.]

With knowledge from his previous life and his new powers, Luke will defy fate and reshape the future, uncovering mysteries beyond Quirks — Conformity? Singularity? A war that has ruled this world since the dawn of Quirks and beyond?

With a foul-mouthed raven, named Nyx, and his memories as companions, Luke must spread Mr. Fool’s faith, while uncovering the dark secrets related to his and his family’s death.

In a world swaying on the edge of something far greater than Heroes and Villains, Luke must walk the line between science and divinity, justice and madness. Because this time—

— he alone will decide how the story ends.

*******************

Note: Luke is not a villain. However, as the story progresses, he ends up becoming a gray character with questionable actions in the eyes of Heroes, Villains, and himself

If you would like to read something truly villainous, check out my other fic: Chaos and Order - A Multiverse Fanfic, featuring Kai as the Blood Demon in a Multiverse setting!

items.title: Divine Lord: The Family System, More Children, More Blessings.
items.synopsis: Rennes transmigrates into a world of gods and demons hoping to become a mighty hero, but with poor aptitude and no special power, he settles for inheriting the family business, marrying, and having children instead. After his first child is born, a Family System awakens, rewarding him with cultivation and skills based on each descendant's talent. Chasing godhood, Rennes commits to fathering as many children as possible, eventually becoming a divine ruler with descendants spread across the world.
items.synopsis_original:
Rennes transmigrated across to a fantasy world where the gods and demons exist.

Originally, he wanted to become a strong man and achieve great things.

However, his aptitude was very low, and he didn't have a gold finger yet, so he can only go home and inherit the family business, marry a wife and have children.

However, after the birth of the first child, Gold finger suddenly awakened.

Rewards are given by the Family system as long as he have kids

[The descendant's have no magic aptitude, his fighting spirit aptitude is low, and the overall evaluation is black iron level, you will get one year of fighting qi cultivation. 】

In order to become a god and live forever, Rennes had no choice but to embark on the road of no return to spread his seeds all over the world.

Years later, his descendants spread all over the world.

He himself also became the king of the gods, a True Supreme in the Multiverse.

items.title: Ultragenic Warlord
items.synopsis: Humanity discovers the dimensional world, a treasure trove of ever-stronger lifeforms whose soulshards and gene fragments let hunters assimilate power and become genetically enhanced fighters. Zhang Lie, a seasoned explorer who once reached the fourth of five known realms, is suddenly thrown back into his youth, to the earliest days of exploration before the world's secrets are known. Armed with foreknowledge, he sets out to blaze humanity's path forward.
items.synopsis_original: The discovery of the so-called dimensional world heralded a new era for humanity. This world, populated with lifeforms of ever-increasing strength, would soon become known as a treasure trove for those hunters willing to brave its risk. Soulshards and gene fragments obtained by killing such lifeforms could be assimilated into their bodies, transforming them into genetically enhanced fighters and setting the stage for the age of genetic enhancement.Zhang Lie, a seasoned fighter who had once explored the fourth of the five known realms of the dimensional world, finds himself thrown back into his youth, to the initial heyday of exploration and growth, before the secrets of this new world had been mined and revealed to all. Armed with foreknowledge, Zhang Lie will blaze a path for humanity to the stars—and beyond.

items.title: The Regressed Demon Lord Is Kind
items.synopsis: A lifetime of bloodshed earned him the title Demon Lord of Strength, until a party of heroes struck him down. Dying, he hears the hero's parting wish: that his next life be a kind one. Then he wakes in the past, restored to his younger self. Uncertain how kindness even works, the former tyrant sets out to reshape his brutal legacy into something gentler.
items.synopsis_original:
My whole life, all I wanted was power.

I churned the world into rivers of blood and eventually gained the title, ‘Demon Lord of Strength’. However, all this became useless when I lost to a party of heroes.

But what can a loser say? As I laid dying, I was forced to listen to the hero’s gibberish:

“If you are born again, I hope that you will live a kind life!”

But huh? When I opened my eyes again, I was back in the past.

“What do I have to do to live a kind life?”

This is the beginning of an ex-Demon Lord’s journey to live a ‘kind’ life.

items.title: Lord Of Pets
items.synopsis: In a world teeming with monsters, demons, angels, giants, elves and beastfolk, human masters bond with familiars through contracts, raising and evolving them for battle. In the Great Qian Dynasty, a youth named Bai Wushang unexpectedly becomes an autonomous awakener, only to discover that his life-bound pet is a humble Moonrabbit, setting him apart in a society built on taming, grooming and monstrous evolution.

items.title: Global Lords: I Have Information System
items.synopsis: Overnight, the entire world wakes up transmigrated into another dimension, everyone reborn as a lord starting with a small yard and three farmers. Survival means exploring maps, seizing territory, gathering resources, and fighting off monster nests and rival factions. Zong Shen gains a strategy system that reads hidden information from everything around him, guiding him toward buried treasures, warning him off traps, and revealing secrets other lords would never notice.
items.synopsis_original:
Everyone in the world had transmigrated to an alternate dimension overnight.

Everyone here was a lord. They could choose their background and obtain a small yard and three farmers at the start.

Lords needed to explore the maps and occupy territories to obtain resources, develop and expand, and conquer monster nests.

They had to defend themselves against monster invasions and attacks from various factions to survive.

Zong Shen awakened the strategy system at the start.

There would be strategic information on everything he saw.

The system helped him to find every hidden treasure.

[The crooked tree 50 meters southeast of the territory is not as simple as it seems.]

[You will get a surprise if you walk 35 steps to the front and start digging.]

[Stop looking, this treasure chest is a trap. The poison gas within will knock you out for three days.]

extra.webnovel_matched_title: Global Lords: I Have Information System

items.title: Reincarnated Lord: I Can Upgrade Everything!
items.synopsis: Asher dies on Earth in humiliating fashion and wakes inside the body of a baron's bastard son, the last surviving Ashbourne. To keep his name and territory alive, he must rebuild from nothing in a world where beasts hunt the weak and ambitious nobles circle anyone without power. Fortunately, he isn't entirely alone: a mysterious system has bound itself to his soul, offering him a way to upgrade his fortunes and fight for survival.
items.synopsis_original:
After leaving earth in a pathetic way, Asher finds his soul in the body of a baron's bastard son.

As the last surviving member of the Ashbournes, Asher must take up the mantle and build his territory or die in the jaws of a beast or the blades of hungry nobles greedy for his territory.

Luckily, he did not enter this man-eat-man world without support.

[Ding! Soulbinding successfully completed.]

items.title: Lord Of Prayer
items.synopsis: Zhou Chen stumbles into possession of a strange Wish Bottle, one that rewards him with "Wish Points" whenever he grants someone else's desire. Suddenly eager to hear people's troubles, he starts fielding requests both mundane and desperate, from exhausted workers begging for a break to others pleading for help finishing their tasks, each granted wish quietly making him stronger.
items.synopsis_original:
Zhou Chen unexpectedly obtains a mysterious Wish Bottle. By fulfilling the wishes of others, he can acquire "Wish Points" to enhance himself.

"Well, do you guys have any wishes?"

"A break! We need a break!"

"Someone come help me finish my work..."

items.title: Urban Undying Lord
items.synopsis: Ye Xuan claws his way back from extinction, rising out of a sea of blood as thunder splits the sky above him. He returns to the city not as a hero but as a great demon king reborn, cold, ruthless, and violent. This is no tale of sainthood or gentle redemption; it is the dark, brutal return of something the world thought long dead.
items.synopsis_original:
Rising from a sea of blood, revived from extinction, as thunder cracks across the sky, Ye Xuan walks out of the blood sea…
PS: This book is of a dark genre, the protagonist is cold and ruthless, it is not a tale of sainthood, there are no kneeling women, the protagonist is extremely violent. This is the story of a great demon king’s return to the city, perhaps… this book has what you desire.
Those of faint heart should not read this book, and neither should moral saints. Please consider carefully before falling into this pit, whether you want to read this book.

items.title: Global Lords: My Species Can Mutate
items.synopsis: When the Ten Thousand Realms collapse into one, everyone is dropped onto the Primordial Continent as a lord, given a starting territory and species to build and battle with. Wolf pups, skeletons, mechanical birds—every type seems workable except Plant Type, considered the weakest. Lin You gets exactly that, a lone battle-useless sapling, and despairs, until he realizes his little sapling can mutate.
items.synopsis_original:
The Ten Thousand Realms collapse, returning to one realm.

Everyone descends upon the Primordial Continent, becoming a lord, battling for survival.

Upon descending, everyone receives an initial territory, recruits species, and strengthens their territory.

“Oh no, I randomly got a Beast Type territory, and can only recruit wolf pups!”

“I got something similar, an Undead Type, and my initial species are little skeletons!”

“What is this Mechanical Factory nonsense? Only giving me a mechanical bird, how am I supposed to survive?”

“Haha, you guys have it good. I heard the initial species for the Plant Type is the worst; someone randomly got a sapling with no battle strength at all!”

Lin You looked at these messages floating by and then glanced at the large words “Plant Type” on his territory information, crying.

How is this supposed to work?

But gradually, he discovered that the little sapling he recruited could mutate!

extra.webnovel_matched_title: Global Lords: My Species Can Mutate

items.title: Demon Lord's Reincarnation
items.synopsis: The strongest Demon Lord dies and wakes again in a human body, stripped of the power that once defined him. He now walks among mortals, piecing together fragments of a past he cannot fully remember. As he searches for answers, he uncovers hidden truths about who he really was, and secrets buried within himself that even he never suspected existed.
items.synopsis_original:
The strongest Demon Lord dies, and reincarnates as a human. Not only that, he because of various incidents turns into the hero’s best friend.

Follow his journey as he tries to help the hero escape his fate, and on the sideline to conquer the continent while he’s at it.

items.title: Swamp Lord With An Intelligence System
items.synopsis: Lear arrives in a fantasy world of extraordinary power and becomes a Pioneer Lord, sent to carve a territory out of a crisis-ridden Wilderness held by barbarians, evil dragons, vampires, beastmen, lizard-men and snake-men. Broke and powerless, his conquest seems hopeless until an Intelligence System awakens within him, feeding him precise, star-rated forecasts—migrating ox herds, a weakened egg-laying dragon—that could turn the odds in his favor
items.synopsis_original:
Lear traveled to a Fantasy World with Extraordinary Power and became a Pioneer Lord, tasked with expanding into the crisis-ridden Wilderness to establish his own territory.

However, the Wilderness is occupied by Barbarians, Evil Dragons, Vampires, Beastmen, Lizard-men, Snake-men...and other evil races.

He is penniless and has not gained Extraordinary Power, yet he wants to expand into the Wilderness and establish his territory under countless fierce gazes. It's almost impossible!

At this moment, the Intelligence System quietly awakened—

[In three days, a herd of migrating Giant Horned Oxen will pass through your territory. (Intelligence Value: 2 Stars)]

[In five days, a Giant Dragon will lay a Dragon Egg in a valley 30 kilometers south and will become weak due to labor difficulties. (Intelligence Value: 4 Stars)]

extra.webnovel_matched_title: Swamp Lord with an Intelligence System

items.title: Industrial Cthulhu: Starting As An Island Lord
items.synopsis: A protagonist begins building factories on his island, only to discover this world runs on idealism rather than industry, treating machinery, ore, and production with the awe and dread others reserve for eldritch horrors. What he creates using ordinary industrial might is perceived as something incomprehensible and terrifying, an unstoppable force whose ships, steel, and smoke inspire the same madness-inducing reverence once given to dark gods.
items.synopsis_original:
“I saw with my own eyes that they used giant beasts as tall as mountains to devour soil and rocks, digging out underground cities, just to park their steel carriages beneath the surface.”

“I saw with my own eyes that they fed glowing ores into an everlasting stellar furnace, unleashing a radiance brighter than the sun.”

“I saw with my own eyes all those indescribable things.”

“Their iron birds covered the sky, their steel ships filled the ocean, their war machines tore the earth asunder, and their gods walked upon the world.”

“You must think I’m mad.”

“But it doesn’t matter.”

“It has already seen you.”

***

Oil is Its blood.

Thick smoke is Its breath.

Ore and steel are Its food.

The countless cargo ships in the harbors are Its myriad offspring.

The place of origin stamped in the corner is Its silent mockery.

They claim they are mere mortals.

Child, you’d best not argue.

You must understand:

Their technology is beyond comprehension.

Their production capacity is unimaginable.

A mere glimpse of their creations will drive you insane.

Their morale surpasses even the most fanatical worshippers of dark gods.

How will you stop them?

With your sword, child? Or your flesh and blood?

You should be grateful that they still consider themselves mortals.

***

“I’ve finished building my factory, and now you’re telling me this world runs on idealism?!”

“Wait, then what the hell did I just create?”

items.title: Global Lord: My Undead Can Undergo Fission
items.synopsis: A giant mouth in the sky devours Earth, scattering its fragments across the void. Survivors awaken with the developmental power called Lord's Cottage, forced to fight for survival in the Myriad Heavenly Hunting Grounds. Fang Jie uses his starting item, the Faction Conversion Command, to claim the undead faction, gaining a fission talent that lets his undead subordinates split and multiply, with room to grow stronger still.
items.synopsis_original:
A gigantic mouth appeared in the sky and swallowed the entire Earth, scattering the shattered fragments everywhere.
“Welcome to the Myriad Heavenly Hunting Grounds, your talent is the Lord’s Cottage.”
Earthlings received the developmental ability called Lord’s Cottage, beginning their struggle for survival in the Myriad Heavenly Hunting Grounds.
Fang Jie, holding the initial item ‘Faction Conversion Command’, gently tapped on the undead faction. Starting with the undead fission talent, he could make his subordinate undead split and increase in value, and the talent could also be upgraded.

items.title: Game Lord's Cultivation System
items.synopsis: Jiang Ming is the world's top player in a virtual reality MMORPG, until he dies in real life mid-game. Rather than ending, his achievement rewrites his fate: he wakes anew in the Northern Continent, a world built on cultivation. Armed with the knowledge and skill he mastered in-game, he sets out to prove himself unmatched, refusing to be treated as some nobody.
items.synopsis_original:
What happens when one dies in real life while playing a virtual reality MMORPG game?

Do they just die there?

No, their life isn’t over as long as they’ve accomplished something that no one has ever done before.

Witness the birth of the top number 1 player, Jiang Ming! He shall start afresh in the Northern Continent. With his sheer knowledge and proficiency in cultivation from the game, he shall become the most overpowered person.

"Remember carefully, I'm Jiang Ming and not some nobody!"

items.title: Crimson Overlord
items.synopsis: At the dawn of the universe, chaos gives rise to the Origin World, ruled by beings born from Black, White, and the five elements, until calamity destroys it and countless worlds with it. Two billion years later, in a small, obscure world, a baby is born carrying an unusual, ancient past tied to that vanished era.
items.synopsis_original:
At the beginning of the universe, there was only chaos. Chaos gave birth to a world, accumulating into Black and White and the five elements (also known as the Origin Elements), creating the world's laws and the order of heaven and earth.

This world was called the Origin world, where the Original beings born out of chaos reigned. They created orders, creatures, and numerous worlds where they reigned as Supreme beings until a calamity befell them and destroyed the Original world alongside numerous worlds.

Two billion years have passed since then. In a small world somewhere, a baby was born carrying an unusual past.

items.title: Lord Of The Truth
items.synopsis: A young man rejects the well-worn path of his predecessors, refusing to chase strength just to measure himself against others. He wants far more than that. His quiet declaration of ambition proves anything but harmless: those simple words unravel a peaceful world, igniting wars that no one can stop.
items.synopsis_original:
"Why would i take the same route as my ancestors ?

why should i become stronger? to hit this and compete with that..?

NO! that's not what i was born for.

what i want is more... much more."

simple words said by a youth..had brought the peaceful world to unstoppable wars.

items.title: Lord Of Mysteries: Starting As A Reader
items.synopsis: A Lord of the Mysteries fanwork where Ebner, an actual transmigrator, steps in to steer Klein toward a better fate. This time the true Lord of the Mysteries is meant to be Klein himself, not the Celestial Worthy of the original story. Following this changed path, the protagonist advances along the Reader Sequence pathway toward that destiny.
items.synopsis_original:
Lord of Mysteries fanfiction. The unexpected intervention of a real transmigrator, Ebner, would help Klein usher in a better ending. The Lord of the Mysteries would definitely be Klein, not the Celestial Worthy. The main character takes the Sequence pathway of a Reader.

items.title: The Lustful Time Lord's Revenge
items.synopsis: Adam attends the world's premier Hunter Academy, where power and awakening decide everyone's worth, but he fails to awaken and becomes the sole ordinary student, mocked relentlessly by peers while his stepmother and stepsisters treat him as worthless at home. Humiliated on all fronts, he finally awakens something forbidden after his stepsister tramples him: the power to stop time, paired with a depraved System built solely for revenge. Adam begins punishing those who wronged him, bending them to his will, and assembling a guild of submissive, beautiful women as he rises from powerless outcast to the Depraved Time Lord.
items.synopsis_original:
[Warning: Mature Smut Content!]

Having incredible powers, diving into dungeons to hunt monsters, and being celebrated as an idol worshiped by countless people—that’s what it means to be a Hunter. Becoming one is the ultimate dream of all people. But not everyone can achieve it, because the first requirement is awakening.

Adam, a student at the world’s most prestigious Hunter Academy, failed. Powerless, he became the only ordinary person among them, mocked and bullied without end.

Home was no better. His stepmother and stepsisters treated him as less than garbage. Adam’s life was nothing but hell with no escape. Until one day, as his stepsister trampled him, something inside finally awoke.

From that day on, everything changed. One by one, he punished those who tormented him, bent them to his will, and began building a guild of beautiful women who submitted to him.

This is the rise of Adam, the Depraved Time Lord.

.

.

.

Warning: This story is a work of fiction. All events, actions, and behaviors depicted are purely imaginary and are not meant to be imitated, justified, or encouraged in real life under any circumstances.

items.title: The Doomsday Lord: Starting As A Insect Queen
items.synopsis: On her eighteenth birthday, Baiyi discovers her family's sudden wealth—then the world ends. The apocalypse hands out lord qualifications, scattering humans across countless worlds. Her cheat power is genetic weaving, but everyone else's seems stronger, so she settles for playing support, quietly farming. Yet her troops keep turning strange, invaders keep dying to insects and crops, and she insists she's just an ordinary farming lord, not some Insect Queen.
items.synopsis_original:
Here, you can see the past and present of the cosmic swarm, the origin of the war-mongering witch tribe, the rise of sea progeny, the birth of giant beasts…
And…
A world tree cultivation from scratch?
…
On her 18th birthday, Baiyi suddenly learns that her family is actually super-rich.
After finally coming to terms with the reality and preparing to embrace a new life, another change occurs.
The world is destroyed, the apocalypse arrives, and humans are given a lord qualification and randomly thrown into millions of worlds.
Good news, her cheat finally arrives, and it’s a seemingly powerful genetic weaving.
Bad news, others have it too, and theirs seem even stronger.
What else can be done?
She can only be a support player trying to get by, relying on her cheat to do some farming.
But why do her troops start to look so strange?
…
I just want to farm properly, so why is it my fault if intruders get taken down by insects/gardeners/crops!
What Insect Queen, what original witch, it’s all slander!
I’m just an ordinary support lord!
ps: Female protagonist, single, farming, dedicated to hybridizing all kinds of strange creatures
pps: This is a male-oriented novel, if you have not read a male-oriented female protagonist novel before, I’m glad this will be your first.

items.title: Lord Of Entertainment
items.synopsis: A man reborn in a world of magic and monsters builds Hellfire Studios, launching his empire with a shameless copy of "The Demonfather" from his past life. Success snowballs as he unleashes "The Lord of the Rings," invents computers and video games, produces music hits, and introduces comics, manga, and anime. Awed audiences of humans, elves, and dwarves start worshipping him as the Lord of Entertainment.
items.synopsis_original:
In a world of magic and monsters, I carved out my own empire. Hellfire Studios - my brainchild, my legacy.

It all started with “The Demonfather” - a blatant copy from my past life, sure, but this world had never seen anything like it. Humans, elves, dwarves - they all fell in love with it. Critics raved, audiences cheered, and suddenly, I was on top.

But the world thought I was a one-hit wonder. They had no idea what was coming.

I unleashed “The Lord of the Rings” upon them. The result? Critics were left speechless, fumbling for words to describe what they'd witnessed

But why stop at movies? This world was stuck in the past, so I dragged it into the future. I created computers, birthed video games, and watched as everyone from imps to elf elders became addicted to pixels and polygons.

Still not satisfied, I turned to music. I crafted stars, produced hits, and soon had the entire realm dancing to my tunes.

But even that wasn't enough. Comics, manga, cartoons, anime, novels - I introduced them all. I flooded this world with stories and art forms they'd never dreamed of.

Before long, people weren't just consuming my creations - they begun worshipping me. They started calling me “The Lord of Entertainment.”

items.title: Amon, The Legendary Overlord
items.synopsis: At five, Amon awakens the unique "Fury" genetics, which warps his behavior. Eleven years with his grandparents teach him control, until they fake their deaths for unknown reasons, forcing him to move away. Now he must adjust to a new life with his mother, stepfather, and two unrelated twin sisters, while also starting school.
items.synopsis_original: At age 5, Amon unlocks the unique “Fury” genetics and is what caused his behavior to change. After living with his grandparents for 11 years he learned to behave. For reasons he can't know, his grandparents faked their deaths, and now he needed to move. Now he would have to face a new challenge which was to live with his mother and stepfather and two twin sisters not linked by blood and go to school.

items.title: Ultragene Warlord
items.synopsis: Humanity discovers a dimensional world teeming with ever-stronger lifeforms, whose soulshards and gene fragments let hunters assimilate power and become genetically enhanced fighters. Zhang Lie, once a seasoned explorer who reached the fourth of five known realms, is suddenly thrown back into his youth, to the early days of this new frontier. Armed with knowledge of what's to come, he sets out to reshape humanity's path among the stars.
items.synopsis_original:
The discovery of the so-called dimensional world heralded a new era for humanity. This world, populated with lifeforms of ever-increasing strength, would soon become known as a treasure trove for those hunters willing to brave its risk. Soulshards and gene fragments obtained by killing such lifeforms could be assimilated into their bodies, transforming them into genetically enhanced fighters and setting the stage for the age of genetic enhancement.

Zhang Lie, a seasoned fighter who had once explored the fourth of the five known realms of the dimensional world, finds himself thrown back into his youth, to the initial heyday of exploration and growth, before the secrets of this new world had been mined and revealed to all. Armed with foreknowledge, Zhang Lie will blaze a path for humanity to the stars—and beyond.
